visualCharacteristics: An authorable vertical gap or full-bleed colored band. Renders no text — just controlled empty space (optionally tinted) between sections.
contentPattern: Key/value rows: desktop (height >= 1200px), tablet (height >= 992px), mobile (height below 992px), and optional color (raw CSS color, var(--x), or a design-token name). Stack multiple spacers to build banded separators.
usage: Insert deliberate vertical spacing between sections, or a colored separator band.
